prompt:

a warm golden-brown complexion, early 20s woman, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, waist-length braids balayage hair — wearing a minimal outfit made entirely of glossy deep-red satin fabric: a cross-wrap top made of two narrow flat deep-red satin fabric bands, each only two fingers wide, that start at the sides of her ribs, rise diagonally across each breast and cross in an X at the center of her chest, then continue up over the opposite shoulders and tie behind her neck, fully opaque and covering only what it must, leaving the curve of her bust visible above and below the bands, with no cups, no bra and no other garment on her chest, and a low-rise micro bikini bottom of one tiny opaque deep-red satin fabric triangle on thin side strings of the same material tied at the hips, fully opaque and covering only what it must, her stomach bare. Background: a bright spring garden terrace of pale stone with blooming tulip beds, a low trimmed hedge, a standard-height garden gate and a bench, in clear sunny daylight, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void.
